actions.title: A ten-minute easy walk
actions.description: Step outside and walk at a pace that feels comfortable.

actions.title: A lunchtime walk
actions.description: A short loop near work or home before or after you eat.

actions.title: Walk and talk with a friend
actions.description: Pick a route you both like and chat as you go.

actions.title: A walk after dinner
actions.description: A relaxed loop on a route that feels comfortable and well lit.

actions.title: An evening walk with someone
actions.description: Walk a well-lit route with a friend or neighbour once the day has slowed down.

actions.title: A brisk 30-minute walk
actions.description: A steady pace that you can still talk at.

actions.title: Run-walk in your neighbourhood
actions.description: Mix easy jogging with walking breaks, whenever you like.

actions.title: A 10-minute easy jog, any pace
actions.description: Jog slowly and walk whenever you want to.

actions.title: Jog and walk: 4 rounds of 3 minutes
actions.description: Jog gently for three minutes, then walk for as long as you need, four times.

actions.title: A run group that welcomes beginners
actions.description: Look for a group that has walkers and beginners, and set your own pace.

actions.title: Quick 30-minute gym session
actions.description: Ask staff for a quick tour, then pick a few machines and go at your own pace.

actions.title: Fifteen minutes on one machine
actions.description: Choose a stationary bike, keep it easy, and ask staff to show you how.

actions.title: A light strength circuit
actions.description: Follow a beginner routine of simple moves with light weights.

actions.title: Ten minutes of stretching at the gym
actions.description: Use the mats and stretch whatever feels tight.

actions.title: A drop-in group class
actions.description: Choose a beginner or all-levels class and go at your own pace.

actions.title: An easy 20-minute ride
actions.description: Ride somewhere flat and quiet, and keep it relaxed.

actions.title: Cycle part of your trip
actions.description: Ride one leg of a trip you already make, on a quiet route.

actions.title: An easy ride on a stationary bike
actions.description: Pedal at a comfortable pace while you watch or listen to something.

actions.title: An easy 20-minute swim
actions.description: At a pool with a lifeguard, swim relaxed laps and rest whenever you like.

actions.title: A few relaxed pool laps
actions.description: At a pool with a lifeguard, swim slowly with plenty of breaks.

actions.title: A beginner swim class
actions.description: Learn or refresh the basics with an instructor and others.

actions.title: Shoot hoops for 15 minutes
actions.description: Take your time and enjoy the shots, no game needed.

actions.title: A casual basketball game
actions.description: Look for a game that welcomes beginners, and sit out whenever you want.

actions.title: An easy rally with a friend
actions.description: Hit back and forth with no score and no pressure.

actions.title: A casual badminton game
actions.description: Play a relaxed game at a local hall or court.

actions.title: Hit a ball against a wall
actions.description: Practice on your own against a practice wall.

actions.title: A casual team game
actions.description: Look for a friendly game that welcomes beginners, and take breaks when you need.

actions.title: Pass a ball around
actions.description: Pass or kick a ball back and forth with a friend, nice and easy.

actions.title: A social league night
actions.description: Look for a social league that welcomes all levels, and play as much as you like.

actions.title: Beginner pickleball social
actions.description: Look for a beginner session where everyone rotates and learns together.

actions.title: A drop-in pickleball session
actions.description: Turn up, join a game and play at your own pace.

actions.title: Gentle pickleball shots with a friend
actions.description: Trade gentle shots at the net and keep it light.

actions.title: Ten minutes of gentle stretching
actions.description: Slow stretches you can do on the floor at home.

actions.title: A slow yoga flow at home
actions.description: Follow a gentle video or just move how it feels good.

actions.title: A beginner yoga class
actions.description: A calm class with room to go at your own pace.

actions.title: Dance to three songs
actions.description: Put on songs you like and move however you want.

actions.title: A beginner dance class
actions.description: Look for a beginner class and learn a few steps at your own level.

actions.title: A social dance night
actions.description: An easy evening of dancing, with or without a partner.

actions.title: An easy trail walk
actions.description: A short, well-used path in daylight where you can stop whenever you like.

actions.title: A short group walk outdoors
actions.description: Look for a group on a marked route, and head back early if you need to.

actions.title: Intro to bouldering night
actions.description: A beginner session at a climbing gym with someone to show you the basics.

actions.title: Easy climbs, take your time
actions.description: After an intro session, choose the easiest routes and rest between each one.

actions.title: A fifteen-minute mat session
actions.description: Follow a beginner video of simple floor moves, done slowly on a mat.

actions.title: A beginner pilates class
actions.description: A small class with an instructor to guide you.

actions.title: Take the stairs for a few floors
actions.description: Take the stairs up one or two floors, at your own pace.

actions.title: A five-minute stretch break
actions.description: Stand or sit and stretch wherever you are.

actions.title: Gentle moves from a chair
actions.description: Slow arm circles and leg movements while seated, as far as feels good.

actions.title: Slow breathing and shoulder rolls
actions.description: Sit comfortably, breathe slowly and roll your shoulders for a few minutes.
